params.prompt:
3x3 sticker sheet, 9 separate characters in equal cells, wide gaps between characters, no character touches or crosses its cell edge.
Subject: teddy bear.
Style: flat vector sticker illustration, bold clean shapes, vibrant colors, friendly proportions.
Cells, row-major:
1. waving hello
2. laughing out loud
3. holding a heart
4. giving a thumbs up
5. thinking with a hand on chin
6. crying
7. angry with crossed arms
8. sleeping
9. celebrating with arms up
Consistency: same character design, proportions and colours in all 9 cells.
Background: flat pure green (#00FF00) background, no shadows, no floor, no gradients, no noise.
Margin: every character is full body, centred, with a generous empty margin on every side (at least 20% of its cell).
